summary: Scope reduction and surviving-rival investigation from merged #731. Read materialized AQUINAS-ST-I-Q4-A2, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q6-A2, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q44-A1 in full, plus pinned q.104 a.1/q.105 a.5 translations. Proved that naming, reduced-description naming and goodness need transfer only for independently characterized universal esse sources and distinct effects; genus at esse supplies the condition before naming. Exact residual scope decomposition and populated strict separator are certified. The secondary-only rival jointly satisfies genus, strict causal ascent, actuality-to-being, formal/eminent preexistence, a universal existential maximum with no distinct incoming esse cause, and active particular/secondary causes while denying even the narrower transfer. Therefore existence dependence plus possession of perfections does not entail causal responsibility under that background. Sources support participation/concurrence but do not state the unrestricted legacy premise or identify every universal esse source with their divine first agent. Rejected: using already named divine concurrence to name the witness; identifying generation with sustaining esse; treating enablement or preexistence as production; attributing denial to Papineau/Hume or the unsourced Durandus label. Semantic grounding, exact locators, comparisons and remaining gaps: docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md. Legacy Challenges and route selection preserved; a sufficient narrower interface is not philosophical closure. Exact frontier effect: all ten legacy route costs, premise counts and open-premise sets unchanged, designated 40/38. Registration changes the legacy target to conditionally proved but unestablished; the global open-item list is 63 to 62, while target remains a route leaf and both narrower/residual obligations remain unestablished. This is classification, not discharge. Direct scope implication is detector-classified as a transcription; only the exact mathematical decomposition and model facts become established. Ledger-I source-defense follow-up(2026-10-31): re-materialized/read full q4a2,q44a1,q3a4,q13a5 Latin and relevant SCGI13[28]–[35] translation context. Positive local q3a4 conditional derives some external esse cause from essence/esse distinction under explicit causal exhaustion and exclusion of sufficient efficient self-origination; it does not require unique God but does not select a common numerical cause. Q44 participation argument adds essentially-held source causality and explicitly imports prior subsistent-esse identity/uniqueness to classify all others as participants and choose one source. Q4 first proof assumes first effective causality before preexistence; its second derives fullness from subsistent esse, not universal causality from weak maximum. Q13 causal analogy preserves causal role but its already certified attribution reconstruction retains causal-order and all-other-creature coverage as explicit inputs. SCGI13[33] causal-first and[34] maximal-being paragraphs do not independently identify their witnesses. Precise source locators, positive reasoning, nonunivocal/analogical boundary and remaining bridges persisted in docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md. No new source claim, definition, Lean proof or philosophical premise discharge. Independent adversarial primary-source audit read Aristotle Metaphysics II/alpha.1 993b24–31 and Aquinas commentary II lect2 nn4–8 [81858–81862]: the cited argument is cause-to-most-such under its univocal qualification, not a derivation that every weak maximum causes all. Q2a3 explicitly asserts the converse, so attribution remains faithful; q44a1 participation chain explicitly imports prior subsistent-esse uniqueness. Weak IsMaximumIn in the universal antecedent strengthens genus causality by including tied/incomparable maxima. This is an applicability/warrant issue, not a demonstrated source-fidelity defect or formal circularity. ROOT-ESSENCE-IDENTITY now implements the independent local q3 causal connection under its eight explicit inputs; no philosophical discharge or global weakening claimed.
blocker: Independent defense of universal transfer: show why a source of every being’s esse actively causes each particular actuality, through or alongside secondary agents, rather than merely making its bearer and powers possible. Identifying the selected witness with q.44/q.105’s subsistent first cause needs additional defended structure; universal esse scope alone does not prove it.
